# Mail the low-stock report every Monday

## Problem

The clerks open the low-stock report by hand. They want it mailed.

## Users

The 3 shift leads get the e-mail.

## Goals

### Goal 1

(1) The mail reaches the 3 shift leads within 10 minutes (G1).

## Non-goals

- Other reports.

## Success measures

- Each of the 3 shift leads gets the mail every Monday. What target does the owner want for a measure?

## Open questions

- Which time on Monday does the mail go out?
